verdict.rationale: Increase documents a programmatic sweep of funds to a network of FDIC-insured institutions, with IntraFi network access available directly in Increase. That is a documented sweep option, but it is framed around expanded FDIC insurance rather than earning yield on idle balances. Missing for 10: any evidence of interest-bearing accounts or yield on swept balances, rate mechanics (how rates are set or paid), disclosure of who keeps the spread, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
